## Finding

`pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:188`:

```rust
fn _accepts(_v: &DefaultVerifier) {}
```

`DefaultVerifier` is a 0-byte ZST. Passing by reference is wasteful. Clippy: `clippy::trivially_copy_pass_by_ref`.

This is also part of finding 11 (underscore binding) — both should be fixed in the same touch.

## Priority

P4 — folded into the same fix as the underscore-binding finding.
title: P4: ZST DefaultVerifier passed by reference in pkix-chain test (clippy::trivially_copy_pass_by_ref)
